data.body: AC completion update: change 2832 merged at 2026-09-08T12:41:16Z with LLM-Review+1, Verified+1, unresolved=0. It adds a no-op-path declared-compose-service check for gerrit, review-bot, and opcert. Decision for dead declared services is fail-loud with AUTODEPLOY_ERROR reason=declared-service-down, not auto-restart, so a crash loop is visible and operator-owned. RED test: tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_declared_services.py; local validation: 71 autodeploy no-op/bluegreen tests passed and full make verify passed before push. Together with change 2819, AC1-AC5 are now checked in the ticket description.
